oncall-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT P1 — EU-prod spike: 5xx rate 18% (baseline <0.1%). Pager routed to oncall:eu-primary. Incident ID 2026-3399. Root message ts=3399990000
Alex: Acked. I'm primary for EU right now. seeing 500s on frontend-gateway, looks correlated with a recent config push.
Maya: I'm secondary, 2min away if you need hands. tagging runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/infra/eu-frontend-500s (see 'Immediate mitigation' section).
Alex: quick check: `kubectl get pods -n eu frontend | grep CrashLoop` — nothing crashing. logs show `upstream: timeout` from auth-service.
Jordan: Auth team here — we rolled a minor cert refresh 7m ago in eu-auth. Reverting cert rotation now.
Sam: Noted customer impact: several customers in EU reporting API errors; billing-affecting paths for search and reconciliation. Escalate to CS if >30min.
Alex: Applying multiplier to gateway timeouts to 10s as quick mitigation:
```
# temp override
gateway.timeout=10s
kubectl apply -f gateway-config-eu.yml
```
Maya: Also enabling prefix KV caching bypass for auth token checks while we stabilize: `feature.flags.auth_kv_bypass=true`
oncall-bot: ACK received from Alex at 3399990010. Escalation timer started (3m to secondary).
Jordan: Revert attempted and cert rollback succeeded at 3399990105. auth-service 200s back to normal.
Alex: Routing normalized, 5xx rate down to 0.4% in last 60s. Keeping eyes on it.
SRE-Lead: Good work. Reminder on escalation rules: page primary first; if no ack in 3m, page secondary; if unresolved after 10m and customer impact high, page SRE-Lead and oncall-phone; for SEV1s with revenue impact, page Eng-Manager and Product-Owner immediately. Update runbook with exact minutes.
Maya: Noted — adding a short checklist to the runbook (checked mitigation steps, rollback, config change id, customer impact note).
Sam: CS notified for impacted customers; raising a support banner and creating follow-up thread to coordinate status page wording.
Alex: Postmortem flags: why cert rotation impacted auth timeouts? follow-up with auth infra. Also we should add a canary + circuit-breaker to cert refresh flow.
Jordan: Will open a PR for canary and update rollout docs.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT 2026-3399: transitioned to MONITORING at 3399990355. Last 5xx rate 0.2%.
Alex: Thanks team. Handoff note for next shift: I'm logging the incident under my handoff notes; please take ownership if you become primary.
Maya: I'll pick this up at the next check-in and confirm no residual errors. :thumbsup: 
SRE-Lead: Closing checklist: update runbook, add rollback id, customer list, time-to-resolve. If anyone has additional telemetry to attach put it in the incident doc.
Alex: attaching quick dumps to incident doc: `s3://redwood-incident-dumps/2026-3399/`
Jordan: closing loop on auth cert root cause investigation. will send follow-up in #eng-security.
Sam: I'll coordinate the post-incident customer comms draft with CS.
oncall-bot: Thread ended. Reminder: if regressions appear, re-page using `incident create --sev P1 --route oncall:eu-primary`.
